name: D9b generic temporal-history factorial
purpose: test whether short generic physical history resolves response-regime ambiguity that additional snapshot data did not
scope: the same 218 fit groups and five episode-blocked folds as D9b scaling; prior inspected TRAIN, DEV, and TEST remain closed

data.subset_rule: reuse the exact deterministic nested episode subsets from D9b scaling
data.normalization: future-action and response normalizers reuse each D9b fold; temporal state/action input normalizers use all non-validation history inputs and remain fixed across fractions

arms.snapshot: reuse the exact seed-1 D9b scaling checkpoints and evaluations at 25 and 100 percent
arms.temporal: replace only the snapshot state MLP with a GRU over four generic states and the three executed controls that connect them; retain D9b future-control encoder, six-level context, shared ReLU amplitude, and softplus shape heads

optimization.sampling: deterministic uniform group sampling without replacement; no class balancing
optimization.execution: one sequential GPU run at a time

decision.pass: replicate the temporal arm with seeds 2 and 3 before any untouched split is opened
decision.fail: short generic history is insufficient; do not tune on these folds or open DEV/TEST, and test a representation with explicit interaction/contact-mode memory
